reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges agent sessions, commands, media, and task execution with Feishu/Lark conversations through persistent messaging and session management.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入飞书/Lark，支持消息交互、卡片命令、会话管理、媒体传输和长任务执行。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Feishu/Lark with message interaction, card-based commands, session management, media transfer, and long-running task execution.

capabilities: Interactive agent sessions with mode, model, permission, workspace, and goal controls
Agent execution with bash, file, subagent, and workflow tools
Inbound image and file handling plus outbound local file sharing
Persistent message queues and session recovery
Diagnostic archive generation containing session logs and configuration data
